note: Exploratory screen for the 2026-09-26 ideation run. Eight occupation/hobby/life families the factory has not screened, plus two calibration controls with known manual verdicts (habit tracker = fortress, bjj training log = dead-zone) so sensor drift is detectable in the same run.
steeringWarning: This file is a SENSOR INPUT, not a build direction. A query appearing here is not a recommendation, and a `candidate` verdict is a spot check over ratings, not a measurement of demand or revenue. Every idea chosen for a slot must come from docs/ideation/ and pass scripts/check-economics.mjs. Calculators, converters and generic arithmetic tools are a closed topic (.cursor/rules/ideation-gate.mdc).

archetypes.label: Professionals whose users are not developers
archetypes.why: The niche-selection heuristic: a job where the person doing the work would never build the app. None of these families has been screened by this factory.

archetypes.label: Tabletop, wargaming and competitive hobby scoring
archetypes.why: Passionate repeat users with discretionary spend, and a job that is pure local state (no server).

archetypes.label: Animal care and training records
archetypes.why: Repeat daily use and an offline-by-nature job. Distinct jobs from the killed farrier/livestock rows, stated so the adjacency is a decision rather than an omission.

archetypes.label: Money and owned-asset records
archetypes.why: A user who already pays for this class of job elsewhere, and a record that is genuinely theirs.

archetypes.label: Daily-use behaviour and health counters
archetypes.why: The highest-frequency use shape the factory can build offline; frequency is what an ads-led plan needs (docs/monetization-strategy.md 2.1). Health claims are a posture question, not a demand question.

archetypes.label: Calibration controls with known manual verdicts
archetypes.why: Known verdicts from docs/niche-selection.md. Used to detect sensor drift, never as candidates.
